title: Implementar barrera durable de contendientes para canaries de PIN
mission: Implement a reusable append-only contention-start barrier for isolated exclusive-PIN canaries so multiple distinct /wc workers can durably arm before racing the same deterministic pin path. Barrier registration must not grant execution authority, timeout/abandon must fail safely without blocking normal allocation, and release must require the fixture's configured distinct entrant count without human timing.
definition_of_done: Distinct workers can append entrant receipts to one isolated fixture without receiving execution authority.
Release becomes eligible only when the configured number of distinct valid entrants is durably present.
After release, entrants still race the ordinary deterministic PIN path; the barrier never selects or grants a winner.
Duplicate entrant receipts from the same worker do not satisfy the distinct-worker threshold.
Timeout/abandon state is explicit and cannot deadlock unrelated allocation.
Deterministic tests cover at least 2-worker and 5-worker release, duplicate entrant suppression, and timeout behavior.
No Current, Human Accepted, Served or production /w pointer is changed.
